proof.source_assumption: A full128-by128 Gram-identity pair of physical pool bases. These necessities need not hold for arbitrary partial frames.
proof.same_sector_selected: Condition on Xa. The other127 selected X vectors modulo span(Xa) and the127 selected Z vectors annihilating Xa form dual bases. A zero-rank witness outside span(Xa, selected phase vectors), annihilating every eligible zero-profile Z, makes the remaining Z dual space too small. A private-owner witness outside span(Xa), annihilating all eligible Z with phase degree<=1, makes the whole127-dimensional opposite quotient pool rank deficient.
proof.opposite_sector_selected: Use the verified physical linear maps X_i↔Z_i, which preserve cross pairings and unchanged indices/phases. The original anchor Z_a becomes X_a; the counted X phase mask becomes Z. A Gram-identity basis allows at most one counted Z neighbor of X_a. Remove it; all remaining phases are in Xa-annihilator and belong to the127-dimensional quotient dual basis. The saved Z quotient witnesses lift through the dual physical basis. They annihilate Xa, and their zero-domain/private-owner contradiction is checked directly against original X vectors.
proof.absence: When Xa is absent, the original opposite dictionary omits Xa. The saved original128-bit deletion witness then has the usual zero-domain/private-owner contradiction. This transfers to original T anchor21 by the same sector map.
proof.monotonicity: A witnessed forbidden phase subset forbids every superset under that anchor event. The producer uses subset-zeta closure; the consumer instead evaluates literal contained-witness predicates.
proof.selected_absent_combination: For q(P)=Pr(anchor=1,P) and g(P)=Pr(P), selected incompatibility forces q=0 and absence incompatibility forces q=g. If both occur, g=0. For orbit32/T21 there are no such both-incompatible masks.

verification: Independent high-pivot physical span replay; direct annihilation tests after128-bit witness lifting; fresh source/sector/phase graph checks; all180 tables per orbit independently reconstructed;672 literal3-dimensional Gram-basis subset controls; zero/span/nonannihilation and table-corruption rejection controls.
scope: Individual necessary anchor/mask compatibility only. No joint-anchor constraint, source frame, infeasibility certificate, source-resolution claim or new cover case is supplied.
